required_scenarios: Agent prepares a payment for human approval
Expired, revoked or replayed delegated authorization
rules: Overall Position is a derived read model and is never mutated by Settle Up.
Selecting Settle resolves one canonical payer, recipient, amount, currency, source scope and payment method.
The Journey 11 primary confirmation prepares or authorizes an exact payment intent; it does not mark receipt or closure.
External or manual receipt requires receiver confirmation.
An exact finalized transfer may close only the exact matched payment item.
Retries reuse the original idempotency scope.
Agents may execute only with valid exact delegation and may not approve themselves or confirm receipt.
Signatures, balances, replay prevention and transition checks are deterministic backend logic.
Payment implementations remain replaceable and secrets never become ChopDot domain data.
